verses.original: טֽוֹב־ רָ֭שׁ הוֹלֵ֣ךְ בְּתֻמּ֑וֹ מֵעִקֵּ֥שׁ שְׂ֝פָתָ֗יו וְה֣וּא כְסִֽיל׃
verses.transliteration: ṭō·wḇ- rāš hō·w·lêḵ bə·ṯum·mōw mê·‘iq·qêš śə·p̲ā·t̲āyw wə·hū ḵə·sîl
verses.literal: Better a poor man who walks with integrity than a fool whose lips are perverse

verses.original: גַּ֤ם בְּלֹא־ דַ֣עַת נֶ֣פֶשׁ לֹא־ ט֑וֹב וְאָ֖ץ בְּרַגְלַ֣יִם חוֹטֵֽא׃
verses.transliteration: gam bə·lō- ḏa·‘aṯ ne·p̄eš lō- ṭō·wḇ wə·’āṣ bə·raḡ·la·yim ḥō·w·ṭê
verses.literal: Even zeal is no good without knowledge and he who hurries his footsteps misses the mark

verses.original: אִוֶּ֣לֶת אָ֭דָם תְּסַלֵּ֣ף דַּרְכּ֑וֹ וְעַל־ יְ֝הוָ֗ה יִזְעַ֥ף לִבּֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: ’iw·we·leṯ ’ā·ḏām tə·sal·lêp̄ dar·kōw wə·‘al- Yah·weh yiz·‘ap̄ lib·bōw
verses.literal: A man’s own folly subverts his way yet his heart rages against the LORD

verses.original: ה֗וֹן יֹ֭סִיף רֵעִ֣ים רַבִּ֑ים וְ֝דָ֗ל מֵרֵ֥עהוּ יִפָּרֵֽד׃
verses.transliteration: hō·wn yō·sîp̄ rê·‘îm rab·bîm wə·ḏāl mē·rē·ʿ·hū yip·pā·rêḏ
verses.literal: Wealth attracts many friends but a poor man is deserted by his friend

verses.original: עֵ֣ד שְׁ֭קָרִים לֹ֣א יִנָּקֶ֑ה וְיָפִ֥יחַ כְּ֝זָבִ֗ים לֹ֣א יִמָּלֵֽט׃
verses.transliteration: ‘êḏ šə·qā·rîm lō yin·nā·qeh wə·yā·p̄î·aḥ kə·zā·ḇîm lō yim·mā·lêṭ
verses.literal: A false witness will not go unpunished and one who utters lies will not escape

verses.original: רַ֭בִּים יְחַלּ֣וּ פְנֵֽי־ נָדִ֑יב וְכָל־ הָ֝רֵ֗עַ לְאִ֣ישׁ מַתָּֽן׃
verses.transliteration: rab·bîm yə·ḥal·lū p̄ə·nê- nā·ḏîḇ wə·ḵāl hā·rê·a‘ lə·’îš mat·tān
verses.literal: Many seek the favor of the prince and everyone is a friend of the gift giver

verses.original: כָּ֥ל אֲחֵי־ רָ֨שׁ׀ שְֽׂנֵאֻ֗הוּ אַ֤ף כִּ֣י מְ֭רֵעֵהוּ רָחֲק֣וּ מִמֶּ֑נּוּ מְרַדֵּ֖ף אֲמָרִ֣ים לֹא הֵֽמָּה׃
verses.transliteration: kāl ’ă·ḥê- rāš śə·nê·’u·hū ’ap̄ kî mə·rê·‘ê·hū rā·ḥă·qū mim·men·nū mə·rad·dêp̄ ’ă·mā·rîm lō hêm·māh
verses.literal: All the brothers of a poor man hate him how much more . . . do his friends avoid him He may pursue them with pleading but they are nowhere to be found

verses.original: קֹֽנֶה־ לֵּ֭ב אֹהֵ֣ב נַפְשׁ֑וֹ שֹׁמֵ֥ר תְּ֝בוּנָ֗ה לִמְצֹא־ טֽוֹב׃
verses.transliteration: qō·neh- lêḇ ’ō·hêḇ nap̄·šōw šō·mêr tə·ḇū·nāh lim·ṣō- ṭō·wḇ
verses.literal: He who acquires wisdom loves himself one who safeguards understanding will find success

verses.original: עֵ֣ד שְׁ֭קָרִים לֹ֣א יִנָּקֶ֑ה וְיָפִ֖יחַ כְּזָבִ֣ים יֹאבֵֽד׃פ
verses.transliteration: ‘êḏ šə·qā·rîm lō yin·nā·qeh wə·yā·p̄î·aḥ kə·zā·ḇîm yō·ḇêḏ
verses.literal: A false witness will not go unpunished and one who pours out lies will perish

verses.original: לֹֽא־ נָאוֶ֣ה לִכְסִ֣יל תַּעֲנ֑וּג אַ֝֗ף כִּֽי־ לְעֶ֤בֶד׀ מְשֹׁ֬ל בְּשָׂרִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: lō- nā·weh liḵ·sîl ta·‘ă·nūḡ ’ap̄ kî- lə·‘e·ḇeḏ mə·šōl bə·śā·rîm
verses.literal: Luxury is unseemly for a fool how much worse . . . for a slave to rule over princes

verses.original: שֵׂ֣כֶל אָ֭דָם הֶאֱרִ֣יךְ אַפּ֑וֹ וְ֝תִפאַרְתּ֗וֹ עֲבֹ֣ר עַל־ פָּֽשַׁע׃
verses.transliteration: śê·ḵel ’ā·ḏām he·’ĕ·rîḵ ’ap·pōw wə·ṯi·p̄·ʾar·tō ‘ă·ḇōr ‘al- pā·ša‘
verses.literal: A man’s insight gives him patience . . . and his virtue is to overlook . . . an offense

verses.original: נַ֣הַם כַּ֭כְּפִיר זַ֣עַף מֶ֑לֶךְ וּכְטַ֖ל עַל־ עֵ֣שֶׂב רְצוֹנֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: na·ham kak·kə·p̄îr za·‘ap̄ me·leḵ ū·ḵə·ṭal ‘al- ‘ê·śeḇ rə·ṣō·w·nōw
verses.literal: A king’s rage is like the roar of a lion but his favor is like dew on the grass

verses.original: הַוֺּ֣ת לְ֭אָבִיו בֵּ֣ן כְּסִ֑יל וְדֶ֥לֶף טֹ֝רֵ֗ד מִדְיְנֵ֥י אִשָּֽׁה׃
verses.transliteration: haw·wōṯ lə·’ā·ḇîw bên kə·sîl wə·ḏe·lep̄ ṭō·rêḏ miḏ·yə·nê ’iš·šāh
verses.literal: A foolish son is his father’s ruin and a quarrelsome wife is like a constant dripping

verses.original: בַּ֣יִת וָ֭הוֹן נַחֲלַ֣ת אָב֑וֹת וּ֝מֵיְהוָ֗ה אִשָּׁ֥ה מַשְׂכָּֽלֶת׃
verses.transliteration: ba·yiṯ wā·hō·wn na·ḥă·laṯ ’ā·ḇō·wṯ Yah·weh ’iš·šāh maś·kā·leṯ
verses.literal: Houses and wealth are inherited from fathers but a prudent wife is from the LORD

verses.original: עַ֭צְלָה תַּפִּ֣יל תַּרְדֵּמָ֑ה וְנֶ֖פֶשׁ רְמִיָּ֣ה תִרְעָֽב׃
verses.transliteration: ‘aṣ·lāh tap·pîl tar·dê·māh wə·ne·p̄eš rə·mî·yāh ṯir·‘āḇ
verses.literal: Laziness brings on deep sleep and an idle soul will suffer hunger

verses.original: שֹׁמֵ֣ר מִ֭צְוָה שֹׁמֵ֣ר נַפְשׁ֑וֹ בּוֹזֵ֖ה דְרָכָ֣יו יוּמָת׃
verses.transliteration: šō·mêr miṣ·wāh šō·mêr nap̄·šōw bō·w·zêh ḏə·rā·ḵāw yū·må̄ṯ
verses.literal: He who keeps a commandment preserves his soul but he who is careless in his ways will die

verses.original: מַלְוֵ֣ה יְ֭הוָה ח֣וֹנֵֽן דָּ֑ל וּ֝גְמֻל֗וֹ יְשַׁלֶּם־ לֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: mal·wêh Yah·weh ḥō·w·nên dāl ū·ḡə·mu·lōw yə·šal·lem- lōw
verses.literal: Kindness to the poor . . . is a loan to the LORD and He will repay the lender

verses.original: יַסֵּ֣ר בִּ֭נְךָ כִּי־ יֵ֣שׁ תִּקְוָ֑ה וְאֶל־ הֲ֝מִית֗וֹ אַל־ תִּשָּׂ֥א נַפְשֶֽׁךָ׃
verses.transliteration: yas·sêr bin·ḵā kî- yêš tiq·wāh wə·’el- hă·mî·ṯōw ’al- tiś·śā nap̄·še·ḵā
verses.literal: Discipline your son for in that there is hope do not be party . . . to his death

verses.original: גֹּרַל חֵ֭מָה נֹ֣שֵׂא עֹ֑נֶשׁ כִּ֥י אִם־ תַּ֝צִּ֗יל וְע֣וֹד תּוֹסִֽף׃
verses.transliteration: gō·ral ḥê·māh nō·śê ‘ō·neš kî ’im- taṣ·ṣîl wə·‘ō·wḏ tō·w·sip̄
verses.literal: A man of great anger . . . must pay the penalty . . . if you rescue him you will have to do so again

verses.original: שְׁמַ֣ע עֵ֭צָה וְקַבֵּ֣ל מוּסָ֑ר לְ֝מַ֗עַן תֶּחְכַּ֥ם בְּאַחֲרִיתֶֽךָ׃
verses.transliteration: šə·ma‘ ‘ê·ṣāh wə·qab·bêl mū·sār lə·ma·‘an teḥ·kam bə·’a·ḥă·rî·ṯe·ḵā
verses.literal: Listen to counsel and accept discipline that you may be wise the rest of your days

verses.original: רַבּ֣וֹת מַחֲשָׁב֣וֹת בְּלֶב־ אִ֑ישׁ וַעֲצַ֥ת יְ֝הוָ֗ה הִ֣יא תָקֽוּם׃
verses.transliteration: rab·bō·wṯ ma·ḥă·šā·ḇō·wṯ bə·leḇ- ’îš wa·‘ă·ṣaṯ Yah·weh hî ṯā·qūm
verses.literal: Many plans are in a man’s heart but the purpose . . . of the LORD will prevail

verses.original: תַּאֲוַ֣ת אָדָ֣ם חַסְדּ֑וֹ וְטֽוֹב־ רָ֝שׁ מֵאִ֥ישׁ כָּזָֽב׃
verses.transliteration: ta·’ă·waṯ ’ā·ḏām ḥas·dōw wə·ṭō·wḇ- rāš mê·’îš kā·zāḇ
verses.literal: The desire of a man is loving devotion better to be poor than a liar

verses.original: יִרְאַ֣ת יְהוָ֣ה לְחַיִּ֑ים וְשָׂבֵ֥עַ יָ֝לִ֗ין בַּל־ יִפָּ֥קֶד רָֽע׃
verses.transliteration: yir·’aṯ Yah·weh lə·ḥay·yîm wə·śā·ḇê·a‘ yā·lîn bal- yip·pā·qeḏ rā‘
verses.literal: The fear of the LORD leads to life that one may rest content without visitation from harm

verses.original: טָ֘מַ֤ן עָצֵ֣ל יָ֭דוֹ בַּצַּלָּ֑חַת גַּם־ אֶל־ פִּ֝֗יהוּ לֹ֣א יְשִׁיבֶֽנָּה׃
verses.transliteration: ṭā·man ‘ā·ṣêl yā·ḏōw baṣ·ṣal·lā·ḥaṯ gam- ’el- pî·hū lō yə·šî·ḇen·nāh
verses.literal: The slacker buries his hand in the dish he will not even bring it back to his mouth

verses.original: לֵ֣ץ תַּ֭כֶּה וּפֶ֣תִי יַעְרִ֑ם וְהוֹכִ֥יחַ לְ֝נָב֗וֹן יָבִ֥ין דָּֽעַת׃
verses.transliteration: lêṣ tak·keh ū·p̄e·ṯî ya‘·rim wə·hō·w·ḵî·aḥ lə·nā·ḇō·wn yā·ḇîn dā·‘aṯ
verses.literal: Strike a mocker and the simple will beware rebuke the discerning man and he will gain knowledge

verses.original: מְֽשַׁדֶּד־ אָ֭ב יַבְרִ֣יחַ אֵ֑ם בֵּ֝֗ן מֵבִ֥ישׁ וּמַחְפִּֽיר׃
verses.transliteration: mə·šad·deḏ- ’āḇ yaḇ·rî·aḥ ’êm bên mê·ḇîš ū·maḥ·pîr
verses.literal: He who assaults his father or evicts his mother is a son who brings shame and disgrace

verses.original: חַֽדַל־ בְּ֭נִי לִשְׁמֹ֣עַ מוּסָ֑ר לִ֝שְׁג֗וֹת מֵֽאִמְרֵי־ דָֽעַת׃
verses.transliteration: ḥa·ḏal- bə·nī liš·mō·a‘ mū·sār liš·ḡō·wṯ mê·’im·rê- ḏā·‘aṯ
verses.literal: If you cease to hear instruction my son you will stray from the words of knowledge

verses.original: עֵ֣ד בְּ֭לִיַּעַל יָלִ֣יץ מִשְׁפָּ֑ט וּפִ֥י רְ֝שָׁעִ֗ים יְבַלַּע־ אָֽוֶן׃
verses.transliteration: ‘êḏ bə·lî·ya·‘al yā·lîṣ miš·pāṭ ū·p̄î rə·šā·‘îm yə·ḇal·la‘- ’ā·wen
verses.literal: A corrupt witness mocks justice and a wicked mouth swallows iniquity

verses.original: נָכ֣וֹנוּ לַלֵּצִ֣ים שְׁפָטִ֑ים וּ֝מַהֲלֻמ֗וֹת לְגֵ֣ו כְּסִילִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: nā·ḵō·w·nū lal·lê·ṣîm šə·p̄ā·ṭîm ū·ma·hă·lu·mō·wṯ lə·ḡêw kə·sî·lîm
verses.literal: Judgments are prepared for mockers and beatings for the backs of fools
